workflow_runs.display_title: fix(web): Recover from stale chunks after a V2 deploy

head_commit.message:
fix(web): Recover from stale chunks after deploy

nginx returns 404 for missing root-level JS and CSS files instead of
index.html, and sends Cache-Control: no-cache for index.html and
ngsw.json. A router navigation error handler loads the target URL once
on a chunk-load error, with a 30-second sessionStorage guard against
reload loops. Records BUG-038.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

workflow_runs.display_title: fix(web): Reserve Accueil caught-up banner space (CLS)

head_commit.message:
fix(web): Reserve Accueil caught-up banner space

The cached inbox can say "Tout est à jour" while the SWR refresh runs.
The banner was not rendered until the refresh ended. It then pushed
"Prochain spectacle" and "Accès rapides" down: one layout shift of about
0.14 on a 375x766 viewport.

Keep the banner box in the layout during revalidation, with
visibility: hidden and aria-hidden. The PERF-12 rule stays: the user does
not see a stale "Tout est à jour" before the refresh confirms it.

Record the defect as PERF-003 in ISSUES.md.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Generated-By: PostHog Desktop
